meta.name: HTTPS Proxy
meta.shortDescription: HTTPS reverse proxy for other pups (TLS self-signed by default + web admin)
meta.longDescription: **How Dogebox maps ports:** each pup declares **one or more exposes** (see [Dogebox docs — ports](https://dogebox.org/docs/usage/ports) and [overview](https://dogebox.org/docs/)). The panel forwards traffic to the **mapped host port** for each expose. **This pup uses two exposes on purpose:** **`https-http`** (plain HTTP, manifest port **10000**) and **`https-tls`** (HTTPS, **10001**). Dogebox may remap those to different host ports — use **whatever mapped port** the UI shows for each. **HTTP:** open **`http://<host>:<mapped HTTP port>/__proxy/`** (what the panel links for Web UI). **HTTPS:** open **`https://<host>:<mapped TLS port>/__proxy/`** in the browser (self-signed cert; accept the warning or trust the cert). **Inside the container:** HTTP listens on **`PUBLIC_PORT`** (default **10000**); TLS listens on **`HTTPS_PROXY_TLS_PORT`** or **`PUBLIC_PORT+1`** — keep **`HTTPS_PROXY_TLS_PORT`** aligned with the **TLS expose** mapping if you override ports. **TLS** uses a self-signed cert with SAN **dogebox** (same hostname on any port). Default admin token **`DOGECOIN`** (**`HTTPS_PROXY_ADMIN_TOKEN`**). Turn **Enable HTTPS** off in admin only if you want **HTTP on a single port** with no TLS listener. **Advanced:** HTTP on each **`listen_port`** row; HTTPS on **`listen_port + HTTPS_PROXY_LISTENER_TLS_OFFSET`** (default **10000**). Not Let’s Encrypt.

sections.name: HTTP/TLS
sections.description: With HTTPS on: **HTTP** listens on `PUBLIC_PORT` (Dogebox panel); **TLS** on `HTTPS_PROXY_TLS_PORT` or `PUBLIC_PORT+1`. With port-listener rows, HTTP on each `listen_port` and TLS on `listen_port + offset` (see long description).

sections.name: Storage & admin
sections.description: Config and TLS material persist under HTTPS_PROXY_STORAGE. Set a fixed admin token to skip the generated admin.token file.
